name: TEST DEMO SUPER INCUBATOR
desc: This is a temporary test instrument to verify automatic website catalog syncing, search indexing, and product page generation for INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS.
principle: Operates using microprocessor PID thermal control for uniform chamber stability during demo testing.
sop: Connect the unit to a 230V AC supply and turn ON the main switch.
Set the required temperature using the digital PID controller.
Allow the chamber to stabilize before placing test samples.
features: SS 304 inner chamber with toughened glass door
